title: Universal Standard vs. June & Vie: Sizing a plus-size leather jacket before a high-cost return
summary: The Leeron moto and June & Vie's belted leather jacket cover different sizes, lengths, and silhouettes. Here is how to compare layering room, rigid-material fit, care, and return exposure.
author: Curvy& Editorial

sections.heading: Real leather makes a sizing mistake unusually expensive
paragraphs: A recent r/PlusSizeFashion shopper wanted a real black leather jacket that could age well instead of another faux jacket that deteriorated quickly. They wore roughly sizes 18–24 depending on cut, wanted sweater room, liked Universal Standard's Leeron, and hesitated at its price. That is not simply a brand-search question; it is a fit-risk question.

Leather may soften with wear, but a new jacket should not depend on dramatic stretching to become wearable. Shoulder width, upper arm, bust, front closure, back reach, and the circumference at the hem all matter. Universal Standard's Leeron and June & Vie's High-Low Belted Leather Jacket offer two very different silhouettes, size systems, and prices for that decision.

sections.heading: The Leeron is a short, boxy moto with the broader size range
paragraphs: Universal Standard describes the Leeron as a boxy moto in 100% genuine leather with a polyester lining, metal hardware, snaps, and deep pockets. Its range runs from conventional sizes 00–0 through 38–40. The brand maps 18–20 to M and 22–24 to L, so carrying a familiar XL into this cart would produce the wrong comparison.

The product page recommends the regular Universal Standard size, but that guidance assumes the intended boxy fit. For sweater layering, compare the product-specific guide and ask for finished chest, upper-arm, shoulder, back, and hem measurements if they are not visible. A larger size can add room, but it can also lower the shoulder, lengthen the sleeve, and change where a short jacket ends.

sections.heading: June & Vie trades moto structure for length and a defined waist
paragraphs: June & Vie's current High-Low Belted Leather Jacket is also a 100% leather shell with polyester lining, but its shape is a 32-inch high-low peplum with a half zipper and self-tie belt. It is offered in grouped sizes from 10/12 through 30/32. This is not a lower-priced duplicate of the Leeron; it changes the silhouette and the areas that must fit.

The official chart maps 18/20 to a 44–46-inch bust, 39–41-inch waist, and 47–49-inch hips; 22/24 maps to 48–50, 43–45, and 51–53 inches. Compare those body measurements with the belt placement and the garment's 32-inch length. A peplum or belt that lands above or below your natural waist can alter comfort and proportion even when the bust closes.

sections.heading: Test the layer, not an imagined future fit
paragraphs: Measure while wearing the thickest layer you realistically plan to put underneath. Then measure a jacket that already allows comfortable driving, reaching, and sitting. Finished-garment measurements are most useful because a body chart does not reveal the amount or location of ease.

Try the new jacket fully zipped, partially open, and seated. Cross your arms, reach forward as if holding a steering wheel, and check whether the shoulders lift, the sleeves bind, the zipper bows, or the hem catches at the high hip. Slight creasing is normal; pain, restricted breathing, a separating zipper, or a lining under obvious tension is not a break-in strategy.
bullets: Prioritize shoulder and upper-arm mobility before waist shaping.
Check bust and high-hip room at the exact points where the jacket closes.
Compare sleeve and back length while wearing the intended sweater.
Budget for professional leather cleaning; both jackets require it.

sections.heading: The return policy belongs in the price comparison
paragraphs: Universal Standard currently requires eligible returns to be initiated within 30 days of shipping. It lists a $4.50 processing fee for Happy Returns and $7.50 for mail returns; final-sale items are excluded. June & Vie states that eligible unworn and unwashed merchandise can be returned or exchanged within 60 days of shipment, with return refunds reduced by shipping and prepaid-label charges; final-sale items are excluded.

Save the product page, size guide, sale status, and policy at checkout. If ordering two sizes would tie up too much credit, request garment measurements first. Choose the Leeron for the classic boxy moto, deeper range through 40, and familiar Universal Standard sizing. Choose June & Vie when the longer belted shape is the actual goal and its range through 30/32 is sufficient. The better value is the jacket whose structure fits now and whose return exposure you can accept.

researchNote: This guide responds to a September 2026 public community request and verifies current materials, size systems, silhouette details, care instructions, and return terms on official brand pages. Prices and sale status can change and should be checked at purchase.
